The '''2007–08 Czech First League''', known as the [[Gambrinus (beer)|Gambrinus]] liga for sponsorship reasons, was the fifteenth season of [[Czech Republic]]'s top-tier of [[association football|football]]. The season started on 4 August 2007 and concluded on 17 May 2008.

==Teams==
[[FK Marila Příbram|Příbram]] and [[1. FC Slovácko|Slovácko]] were relegated to the [[2007–08 Czech 2. Liga|second division]] after finishing last and second to last, respectively, in the [[2006–07 Czech First League|2006–07 season]].

[[FK Viktoria Žižkov|Viktoria Žižkov]] (as champions) and [[Bohemians 1905]] (as runners-up) were promoted from the [[2006–07 Czech 2. Liga|second division]].

*{{note|2|2}} Sparta Prague appointed club president [[Jozef Chovanec]] to the position of caretaker manager for the two remaining matches of the season.<ref name=bilekout/> Following the end of the season, Vítězslav Lavička took over.
